sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Racist attack on shop playing Ahmet Kaya song

place: Kûrta Xanê area, Besta region, Şirnex (Şırnak)
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that village guards from Milakerî and Niyar villages, passing the Turkish army checkpoint at Navyan, were cutting centuries-old monumental trees with chainsaws in the Kûrta Xanê area of Besta, despite official claims that felling had stopped.

place: Bus journey from Amed to Çatalzeytin, Kastamonu
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that 18-year-old Furkan Oğlak, travelling from Amed to a construction job in Kastamonu on 11 July, was harassed and racially attacked by passengers for listening to Kurdish music and called a 'terrorist'; police then detained him and he was jailed the next day on a 'propaganda' charge.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Youth attacked for listening to Kurdish music, then arrested on ‘propaganda’ charge

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Mahir Can Ada, 35, detained at a checkpoint in Cizîr while travelling to the Kurdistan Region over an alleged tip-off, was laid face down inside an armoured vehicle with its cameras switched off and beaten, with officers standing on his ankles; a doctor's report said 'no assault' despite visible injuries and a cast on his foot. He was jailed for 'resisting an officer' and released at his first hearing in August.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Kurdish rice-seller Adem Yıldız and relatives Nuh and Abdurrahman Yıldız were called to Sarıyer Square on 21 July by local shopkeepers who had harassed Adem for being Kurdish, and were attacked by a group of 30–70 people, many with sticks; footage showed the attack and the family said threats continued.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that officials of US-based IGNIS H2 Enerji, escorted by many Turkish gendarmes and machinery, tried to enter Licik village for geothermal plant (JES) field work; villagers blocked the road, saying the project would poison groundwater and destroy pasture.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Nevzat Öner, a prisoner at Van F-Type High-Security Prison, was beaten and tortured by Turkish gendarmes at the hospital on 11 August because he refused to be examined in handcuffs; rights groups and the Van Bar protested and he filed a criminal complaint.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Detained youth in Amed subjected to police brutality

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that machinery was brought back, with gendarmerie sent in, to start a solar power plant on the pasture of Girêsor; livestock-raising villagers blocked the machines.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that more than 70 Kurdish seasonal hazelnut workers and family members from Cizîr and Silopiya were attacked twice over two days in Bektaşlı village; DEM Party MPs called for their safety and an investigation was opened.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Kurdish seasonal workers from Mêrdîn were racially attacked by a group where they were staying in Cumayeri and Gümüşova, days after the attack on Kurdish workers in Zonguldak; the workers sent footage and said they were considering leaving.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency, citing Farqîn co-mayor Kadri Esen, reported that nine Kurdish fig-picking workers wearing Amedspor shirts (Faruk Bağcı, Caner Binen, Muhammednur Binen, Barış Burakmak, Mevlüt Kemaloğlu, Ömer Bağcı, Hasan Benz, Taner Binen, Yusuf Bağcı) were beaten and injured by villagers in a racist attack.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Workers wearing Amedspor jerseys targeted in racist attack

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that the Kurdish-language Mesopotamians Language and Culture Research and Development Association in Çerkezköy was fired on at about 00:10; two bullets hit the premises and three casings were found. One person was detained.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Kurdish language association in Tekirdağ attacked with gunfire

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that prison staff in riot gear raided wards of Erzincan High-Security Prison at midnight and beat and tortured many political prisoners; prisoner Fırat Erbağa told his family he and others were tortured and put in cells.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported footage from the Basa side of Mount Gabar showing tonnes of dynamite used to open at least 11 oil wells, with trees and rocks blown metres into the air and trees around the wells destroyed.

Mezopotamya Agency: New footage reveals environmental destruction on Mount Gabar

sources.title: Mezopotamya Ajansı: Polis İstanbul’da Amedspor taraftarına saldırdı: 3 gözaltı

summary: Mezopotamya Agency, citing Ajansa Welat, reported that Şiyar Çiçek, imprisoned since 2014 and held for about two years in Eskişehir Prison, died under suspicious circumstances after ten days in a solitary cell; his family said he was in good health apart from diabetes.

place: Şax (Çağlayan) and Hebler (Hisar) villages, Cizîr (Cizre), Şirnex (Şırnak)
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that artillery fire from the Turkish army post at Hebler started a fire in the countryside of Şax and Hebler, villages leased to the Defence Ministry for 49 years; it spread through the first-degree protected Şikefta More area, burning orchards and fruit trees while soldiers made no attempt to put it out. Fires had broken out the same way several times before.

place: Şehîd Binevş Cemetery, Basret village, Gabar mountain, Şirnex (Şırnak)
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Turkish soldiers attacked the Şehîd Binevş cemetery of PKK members on Mount Gabar, breaking named gravestones; the cemetery had already been bombed and destroyed from the air and ground in 2015.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Cemetery on Mount Gabar vandalized by soldiers

place: Zîlan valley (Şorik, Karakilise and Çakırbey villages), Erdîş (Erciş), Wan (Van)
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that state-backed geothermal (JES) drilling over 8,860 hectares of the Zîlan valley was destroying farmland and dumping heavy-metal fluids into the valley, and that Şorik, Karakilise and Çakırbey villages faced being emptied.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that gravestones of the PKK cemetery at Sipîndarok on Mount Cûdî, destroyed by bombing in 2015 and closed as a 'military security zone', had been collectively buried in a pit; families searching for graves such as that of Hatice Erbağa found the stones there. When the stones were buried is not stated.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported villagers' complaint that drilling waste from the state oil company TPAO's operations on Mount Gabar was being dumped by tanker into the stream and empty land at Şilyan, polluting the water that about 4,000 sheep and goats drink.

place: Near Qereman village, Dirbêsiyê, on the Turkish–Syrian state border
summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Turkish soldiers stopped three women trying to cross from Dirbêsiyê into Turkey near Qereman village, tortured them and seized their money and belongings.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Agency: Three women reportedly tortured at Dirbêsiyê border
